sub_sector.value: B2B trade show and live event organizing; industry media

service_category.detail: Live trade shows and media properties connecting buyers and sellers in B2B markets.

engagement_model.detail: Exhibitor booth and sponsorship sales per live event, plus media and advertising on its properties.

labor_specialization.detail: Event marketing, sales and production staff with industry market knowledge, not licensed or technical specialists.

client_segment.detail: Exhibitors, brands, manufacturers and retailers across B2B industries; attendees are trade buyers and some consumers.

notes: Labor specialization is a loose fit; no category matches event organizers well.
